title: Transport Network rerun result evidence inline
summary: Transport the canonical Network rerun worker-result object inline in the signed done request, enforce a strict size/type boundary, and stop coordinator probes of worker-local artifact paths.
reason: Remediate P1 AUDIT-FIND-W01-022. Remote workers reported an absolute local artifact path that the coordinator could not normally read; inaccessible paths terminalized valid rerun output as corrupt and also let authenticated workers trigger arbitrary local or UNC probes.
behavior_before: The worker parsed its result JSON locally but sent only its absolute local path. The coordinator dereferenced that caller-supplied path and treated missing, inaccessible, or timed-out worker-local evidence as a corrupt artifact mismatch requiring review.
behavior_after: The worker sends the already parsed canonical artifact as a strict-JSON object inside the HMAC-signed done body. Protocol parsing caps it at 64 KiB. The reducer validates inline schema/job/batch/row/result bindings without path I/O; legacy path-only evidence remains diagnostic and cannot trigger coordinator filesystem or UNC probes or prove corruption.
tests_added: tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_network_lifecycle.py: the worker lifecycle forwards the parsed canonical artifact object with the terminal report.
tests/python/desktop/test_network_protocol_runtime.py: inline worker-result artifacts round-trip additively and oversized strict-JSON objects are rejected at 64 KiB.

tests/python/desktop/test_network_rerun_claims.py: distinct worker/coordinator path namespaces use inline evidence without probing the worker path; legacy path-only evidence is unavailable transport rather than corrupt output and triggers no I/O.
tests/python/desktop/test_network_security.py: changing an inline artifact field invalidates the HMAC-signed done body.
